text:
SRE-Bot: :warning: Paging @prod-oncall. Elevated 5xx rate and node eviction events after partial feature-flag rollout for inference-routing alpha. Alerts: 5xx-rate > 3% for 5m, node.evict count rising. https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/ALRT-921

DeployBot: Feature flag flip initiated: feature/inference-alpha-routing -> ON for 15% traffic (rollout-id=alpha-91). Canary done via routing-layer, not new image.

Alex Morgan: seeing a cluster-wide spike in disk pressure on a subset of nodes (ephemeral-storage). Several inference pods are Pending with imagePull or Init:CrashLoopBackOff.

Ravi Singh: logs from one affected pod: ```
InitContainer init-model-cache failed: failed to write /tmp/model-cache/index.lock: no space left on device
container_linux.go:247: starting container process caused "write /proc/1/fd/1: no space left on device"
```

Oncall - Dana: is this limited to alpha traffic? can we route around the busy nodes?

Alex Morgan: yes, alpha traffic was routed to subset of nodes with label shard=alpha. Looks like nodes in that shard had lower ephemeral storage available due to a housekeeping regression earlier today. The alpha routing is concentrating traffic and causing aggressive cache writes from init containers -> disk fills -> pods crashloop and then evictions.

k8s-bot: Node events: ```
NODE kube-node-43 Warning Eviction {kubelet kube-node-43} The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
NODE kube-node-45 Warning Eviction {kubelet kube-node-45} The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
```

Customer Success - Mei: We're getting reports of 502s for customers using the new alpha routes, ~12 accounts pinged. I'm drafting a short status update.

Ravi Singh: Plan: 1) flip feature flag OFF to stop alpha routing 2) cordon and drain the most affected nodes 3) delete failing pods so HPA doesn't chase them 4) follow up with infra to reclaim disk space and fix housekeeping.

Oncall - Dana: Agreed. Alex, please flip the flag. I'll stage node maintenance.

DeployBot: FeatureFlagService: toggled flag "feature/inference-alpha-routing" -> OFF by Alex Morgan. Traffic rebalanced to default routing at 14:22:13 UTC.

Alex Morgan: done. Confirming 15% traffic removed from shard nodes. Error-rate dropping on frontend metrics.

Ravi Singh: draining nodes: ```
kubectl cordon kube-node-43
kubectl drain kube-node-43 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl cordon kube-node-45
kubectl drain kube-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

k8s-bot: Drain status: some pods with local emptyDir were evicted. HPA observed drop then small surge as replacements scheduled on other nodes.

Infra Eng - Tomas: I'm cleaning up /var/lib/kubelet/pods and rotating the ephemeral cache. Found housekeeping cron failed to run (exit code 2) on those nodes — sysctl overlay issue. Will run cleanup script and restart kubelet.

Ravi Singh: while nodes recovering, patch HPA to increase stabilization window to 60s to avoid over-reactive scaling: ```kubectl patch hpa inference-service -n prod --type merge -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":60}}}}'```

Oncall - Dana: good call. Also, removing alpha nodes from scheduler by label until fixed. ```
kubectl label node kube-node-43 shard=-alpha --overwrite
kubectl label node kube-node-45 shard=-alpha --overwrite
```

Customer Success - Mei: Sent update to affected customers: short disruption localized to alpha routing, we rolled back the flag, estimating 20-30m for full recovery.

Alex Morgan: monitoring shows 5xx rate back to baseline for production routes. alpha-route errors dropping to negligible.

Ravi Singh: follow-ups: (1) add pre-rollout check to ensure target node shard has > 30% ephemeral-storage free (2) change init container cache write path to respect available storage and fallback (3) add cluster housekeeping alert for cron failures (4) make feature flag rollback runbook with one-click rollback in DeployBot. I'll file tickets.

Infra Eng - Tomas: root cause: housekeeping cron failed on a subset of nodes due to sysctl change during earlier maintenance, combined with alpha traffic concentrating cache writes. Remediation: reboot nodes after cleanup and re-enable housekeeping. Will also add disk pressure check to node-provisioning.

Oncall - Dana: creating incident ticket RW-INC-4302 and assigning to Ravi/Tomas for postmortem. Severity: S2. Keeping monitoring for 30m before closing.

SRE-Bot: Incident RW-INC-4302 created. Linked alerts: ALRT-921, ALRT-923. Timeline: start 2026-02-18T14:21:00Z.

Ravi Singh: leaving handoff notes in #eng-runtime with commands to re-run cleanup. I'll own the postmortem and CI gate for feature rollouts.

Customer Success - Mei: will follow up with customers with final timeline once nodes back to green.

Alex Morgan: closing the live thread, will watch for any residual evictions. Nice quick rollback everyone. :thumbsup:
